blurb: Guests go on fishing charters ranging from 2 to 8 hours to catch various species of fish off the coast of Florida. The charters include fishing gear, permits, and guidance from Captain Jared Mong. Fishing locations include flats and the Gulf, targeting species such as Amberjack, Barracuda, Cobia, Grouper, Snapper, Tarpon, and many others.
